main_text.p: Tertium habet ♎︎ ♊︎ ♂ ♒︎ signa calida & humida, sanguinea, aërea, masculina.
Quartum ♋︎ ♏︎ ♃ ♓︎ continet, frigida & humida signa, aquea, phlegmatica, fœminina.
main_text.head: DE ECLIPTICA SEV VIA SOLIS.
main_text.p: MEDIVM zodiacum secundum latitudinem dispescit orbita Solis, quam inde ἡλιακὸν κύκλον graeci, uiam Solis & planum Solis latini: Nonnulli & Ecliptican, quòd Luminaribus in ea coniunctis Sol, oppositis Luna deficit uocarunt. Ptolemæus ἀπὸ situ κύκλου διὰ μεσῶν τῶν ζῳδίων nominat.
Est autem Ecliptica circulus maior in medio zodia-

page.notes: The Greek words are printed in Greek letters as shown; the zodiac sign glyphs in the text are astronomical symbols and are approximated. The last line is partly obscured by a catchword-like mark ("zodia-") and a stray mark ("I ,") beneath it; the line is transcribed as printed. The diagram shows a circle of twelve zodiac signs divided by lines through the centre; it is not transcribed as text.
